items.q: What book & magazine sizes are available?
items.a:
We offer both a5 (5.8” x 8.3”) & a4 (8.3” x 11.7”) options for our hardcover perfect binding photobooks and only a4 (8.3” x 11.7”) for our lay flat photobooks.

Magazines are available in both a5 (5.8” x 8.3”) & a4 (8.3” x 11.7”) options.

items.q: What paper finish options do you offer?
items.a:
For hardcover photobooks we offer a gloss paper finish, and for lay flat we offer a premium luster finish.

All of our magazines come with a gloss paper finish.

items.q: What binding options are available?
items.a: Photobooks are available in either perfect binding or lay flat binding, while our magazines are only available with perfect binding.

items.q: When are you launching new templates?
items.a: We are always launching new templates! The best way to stay in the know is to sign up for our early access list or keep an eye out on our socials!

items.q: What’s the maximum number of pages?
items.a:
Hardcover perfect binding photobooks: 24 - 298
Lay flat photobooks: 24 - 122
Magazines: 24 - 298

items.q: Are your materials sustainable or eco-friendly?
items.a: Yes! Our printing partners use HP Indigo machines with FSC-certified paper — meaning the paper comes from responsibly managed forests that protect nature and local communities. Since we print on demand, each book or magazine is made only when ordered, avoiding unnecessary waste. And thanks to our global print network, every order is produced as close as possible to its destination, helping reduce transport distance and CO₂ emissions.

items.q: Do you print on both sides of the page?
items.a: Yes!

items.q: Is there a print quality guarantee?
items.a: Yes, we offer a 30 day satisfaction guarantee. If you’re unsatisfied with your order please reach out to our dedicated support team support@vectori.com.

items.q: Do you offer square, portrait, and landscape formats
items.a: At this moment we only offer portrait format, however we are working hard to release landscape and square formats soon!

items.q: Can I customize spine text?
items.a: Yep! Once you’re in the editor, simply click on the spine text box and you’ll be able to change the text, color and size. Be careful not to make it too big in case it gets cut off!

items.q: Do you color-correct or edit photos?
items.a: No, we don’t alter or enhance your photos. We only convert files to a print-ready format — changing the color profile from RGB (used for screens) to CMYK (used for printing). However, please note that colors may appear slightly different in print compared to what you see on your screen. This is due to variations in screen settings (like brightness or color calibration) and the natural differences between digital displays and printed materials.

items.q: What’s included in the base price?
items.a: The base price includes 24 pages. The base price will change depending on what book or magazine type you choose.

items.q: Do I have to pay for extra pages?
items.a:
Yes, our extra page costs are as follows:

Photobooks
Gloss paper - $1.99 per additional page ($3.98 per double page spread).
Premium luster - $6.99 per additional page ($13.98 per double page spread).

Magazines
Gloss paper - coming soon.

items.q: Will my images look the same in real life as they do on my screen?
items.a: There might be a small difference in how colors appear in print compared to your screen — that’s completely normal. Screens use light to show colors, while printing uses ink, and things like screen brightness or color settings can make images look a bit different. Your photos will still look beautiful and true to the originals!

items.q: Do you offer gift wrapping?
items.a: Yes! We offer premium gift boxes — just add one in your cart before checkout.

items.q: Do you have a quick tutorial on how to create a custom photobook or magazine?
items.a: Yes! You can check our quick tutorial out by clicking this link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XhclzJS_Jqo

items.q: How do I upload photos from my phone or computer?
items.a:
There are two ways you can upload your photos. Before entering the editor, or while you are in the editor.

If you want to upload photos before the editor, simply select a template and click “start my design” or “start from scratch”, then under “smart photobook”, click “add photos” and choose between uploading from your computer, phone, or previous vectori projects.

If you want to upload photos in the editor, and you're on a desktop or tablet device, navigate to the top left of the editor and click “images”, then once again choose between uploading from your computer, phone, or previous vectori projects.

If you’re on mobile, navigate to the bottom left of the editor, click “photos”, then click “add photos” and you’ll have the option of uploading photos from your phone or previous vectori projects.

items.q: How many photos can I upload at once?
items.a: You can upload as many photos as you like, there’s no limit! If you’re adding a big batch (over 500 photos), the upload might take a little longer depending on your internet speed. If things slow down, it can help to upload your photos in a few smaller batches instead.

items.q: Can I add extra pages?
items.a:
Yes! You can easily add extra pages in our editor. 

If you’re on a desktop device, simply navigate to the bottom right of your screen where you’ll see “add pages” or “duplicate”. Alternatively, you can hover your cursor over the page preview thumbnails along the bottom of your screen, and a “+” sign will appear. Click this and a new double page spread will be added.

If you’re on a mobile device, simply navigate to the top right of your screen, click “more”, then “add spreads” and you’ll be able to choose the amount of pages/spreads you would like to add.

items.q: Can I edit text, fonts, and colors?
items.a: Yes, text, fonts and colors are all fully customisable in our editor.

items.q: Can I switch templates after I start?
items.a:
Of course! If you wanted to change the template you originally picked, you can do so within the editor. 

On desktop, simply head to the side panel to the left of the editor and second from the top, under “images” there will be a “templates” option where you can choose from all of our templates.

On mobile, simply head to the bottom right of your screen where you’ll find an arrow. Click this and a “templates” option will appear. Click this and then select the new template.

Note, if you are in the editor, all of our templates will be accessible, so don’t worry if you entered the editor via a specific collection, you’ll have every template on our website for that product available to you.

items.q: Will my project autosave?
items.a: Yes! Your project will autosave after 5 minutes from when you start. Then it will autosave every 5 minutes, provided you have made changes.

items.q: What should I do if I experience any issues with the editor when creating my project?
items.a: The quickest way to get support when creating your project is through our live chat where our design & technical support team can assist you in real time. If they are currently offline, then reach out to our dedicated support team support@vectori.com who will get back to you within 24 hours.

items.q: Does the editor work on mobile (iPhone/Android)?
items.a: Yes, our editor works on both iphone and android, but please be aware there will be some limitations. For the full editing experience we suggest switching to a tablet or desktop device.

items.q: Which countries do you ship to?
items.a: We currently ship to Australia, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the UAE, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

items.q: How long does shipping take?
items.a:
Shipping times vary depending on where you’re located:

Western Europe: 5–12 business days
Eastern Europe & the US: 10–12 business days

Rest of the world: Around 15 business days, sometimes a bit longer

Please note that delivery may take slightly more time during peak seasons.

items.q: What are your shipping costs?
items.a: Shipping costs vary depending on your location and the product you order, including the number of pages and product type. The exact cost will be calculated and shown at checkout.

items.q: Do you offer free shipping over a certain amount?
items.a:
Yes! We offer free shipping on larger books, but the threshold varies by country:

US, UK, Germany, Czech Republic, Denmark, Netherlands, Sweden: Free shipping for books over 50 pages
Australia, France, Italy, Spain, Belgium, Finland, Portugal: Free shipping for books over 60 pages
New Zealand, Bulgaria, Croatia, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Switzerland, UAE: Free shipping for books over 70 pages
Canada, Norway, Mexico, Singapore: Free shipping for books over 100 pages

The free shipping option will appear automatically at checkout if your order qualifies.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: You’ll receive an email with tracking details as soon as your package is on its way. Simply use the link or tracking number in that email to follow your order’s journey.

items.q: Why hasn’t my tracking updated?
items.a: Sometimes tracking information takes a little while to refresh or update. If it hasn’t changed for a few days, please contact our customer support at support@vectori.com, and our team will be happy to check it for you.

items.q: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
items.a: Unfortunately, once an order is placed, we’re unable to change the shipping address. Please double-check that all details are correct before completing your checkout.

items.q: What if my package is delayed or lost?
items.a: If your package seems delayed or hasn’t arrived, please reach out to our customer support team at support@vectori.com. We’ll be happy to investigate and help resolve the issue.

items.q: Will I pay customs duties or taxes?
items.a:
We work with printing facilities in many countries to help you avoid customs fees and import taxes. If your order is printed and delivered within Australia, New Zealand, the USA, Europe, the UK, Canada, or Mexico, you won’t have to pay any customs charges.

If you’re located outside these regions, local customs fees may apply and are the responsibility of the customer.

items.q: Do you ship to PO boxes?
items.a: Unfortunately we’re unable to deliver to PO boxes. Please provide a full street address at checkout to ensure successful delivery.

items.q: Can I send as a gift without pricing info inside?
items.a: Yes! We don’t include any invoices or pricing information in the package, so it’s perfect for gifting.

items.q: Can I split an order to multiple addresses?
items.a: Unfortunately each order can only be shipped to one address. If you’d like to send books to different addresses, please place separate orders.

items.q: How are the books/magazines packaged?
items.a: Magazines are shipped in a sturdy envelope that usually fits through standard mailboxes. Photobooks come carefully packaged in a protective cardboard box to keep them safe during delivery.

items.q: Do you ship during holidays?
items.a: Orders can still be placed during the holidays, but carriers don’t deliver on the holidays themselves — specifically November 27, December 25–26, and January 1. Deliveries will resume once carriers are back in service.

items.q: What should I do if I experience any issues/delays with the Carrier?
items.a: If your delivery is delayed or you notice any issues with the carrier, please reach out to our customer support team at support@vectori.com. We’ll be happy to look into it and help resolve the problem.

items.q: How do I apply a discount or promo code?
items.a: Discount codes are applied at checkout. When you’ve reached checkout simply enter the code in the designated discount code field and click “apply”. Please note you cannot stack multiple discount codes together, but discount codes will still apply even when there’s a sitewide sale.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: we offer credit/debit card & apple/google pay at checkout

items.q: My payment was declined, what should I do?
items.a: If you encounter any issues while checking out, don’t hesitate to use the live chat or reach out to our dedicated support team support@vectori.com who will be more than happy to help.

items.q: Can I make changes to my project after checkout?
items.a: Once you’ve placed your order, your project files get sent off to our print facilities immediately, which makes it extremely difficult to edit any projects post-order. We encourage all customers to carefully check their projects before ordering, but accidents happen, so if you do happen to run into any issues post-order, please contact our dedicated support team support@vectori.com and we will do our best to help.

items.q: Can I cancel my order after checkout?
items.a: Once you’ve placed your order, your project files get sent off to our print facilities immediately, which makes it very difficult to cancel orders after checkout. We understand that accidents happen, so if you do happen to run into any issues post-order, please contact our dedicated support team support@vectori.com and we will do our best to help.

items.q: I didn’t receive an order confirmation email, what should I do?
items.a: Please check your spam/junk folder. If you still haven’t received a confirmation email after 30 minutes, reach out to our dedicated support team support@vectori.com who will be happy to look into the issue for you.

items.q: How do I download my invoice or receipt?
items.a: On the order confirmation page, simply click “view order summary” and the first option is “download invoice” which will be in the form of a Stripe pdf file.

items.q: How do I reorder a previous project?
items.a: Simply head to your account, locate “my projects”, find the project you would like to reorder, and click “order”.

items.q: Can I add a gift note after ordering?
items.a: Unfortunately we don’t offer gift notes at this current moment, but it’s absolutely something we are looking into!

items.q: Can I combine two orders?
items.a: If you would like to order multiple projects at once, after adding the first project to your cart, simply head back to the editor, create your next project, and add the second project to cart. There are no limits to how many projects you can order at once. It is not possible, however, to combine two different orders on two different accounts.

items.q: Can I use multiple promo codes?
items.a: We only allow for one promo/discount code to be used per order.

items.q: There’s already a sale running, will my promo code still apply?
items.a: Yes!

items.q: How do I update my address?
items.a: Simply head to your account, select “my profile”, scroll down to “edit default address” to edit your default address, or click “view address book” and all of your past addresses will appear. Click “edit” if you wish to make any changes to them.

items.q: Can I switch currency?
items.a: Our site will auto detect your local currency, which means you’ll be shown the default currency for where you’re currently located.

items.q: Can I add another copy to my order?
items.a: Absolutely! After adding your project to cart, simply locate the quantity selector and click “+” to add another copy.

items.q: I made a mistake in my design, but I’ve already ordered, what should I do?
items.a: Contact our support team via live chat or support@vectori.com immediately. We cannot guarantee we will be able to cancel the order, because as soon as you place your order the files are sent off to our print facilities, but we will do our best to make the situation right.

items.q: Do you charge in my local currency?
items.a: Yes, we use stripe as a payment processor, which automatically adapts to your card's currency.

items.q: Is VAT included?
items.a: Yes, VAT is included in all orders.

items.q: What is your return and refund policy?
items.a:
We want you to love your creations! So, we offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you’re not happy with your order, please reach out to our support team atsupport@vectori.com. Damaged or defective books.

If your book arrives damaged or with a printing defect, we’ll happily send you a free reprint. Just contact our team at support@vectori.com and include a few photos of the issue. Design mistakes.

Because each book is custom-made, we’re unable to offer refunds or reprints for design errors made during the creation process. Please make sure to double-check your layout, text, and photos before placing your order.

items.q: Do you offer reprints for damaged or misprinted books?
items.a: Yes, absolutely. If your book arrives damaged or misprinted, please contact our customer support at support@vectori.com and include a few photos of the issue. Our team will review it and arrange a reprint for you.

items.q: How do I start the refund or reprint process?
items.a: To request a refund or reprint, simply contact our customer support team atsupport@vectori.com. We’ll guide you through the next steps and make sure your issue is resolved as smoothly as possible.

items.q: Do you accept returns?
items.a: Once you’ve placed your order, your project files get sent off to our print facilities immediately, which makes it extremely difficult to edit any projects post-order. We encourage all customers to carefully check their projects before ordering, but accidents happen, so if you do happen to run into any issues post-order, please contact our dedicated support team support@vectori.com and we will do our best to help.

items.q: Do I need an account to create a book?
items.a: Yes you will need to sign up for an account to create a project. This enables autosave so your hard work doesn’t get lost and allows us to send you reminders in case a sale is ending soon!

items.q: How do I reset my password?
items.a:
Simply navigate to the “account” page, where you should be displayed with a log in form. Under the password field there should be some underlined text that says “forgot your password?”. Click this and you’ll be taken through the steps to reset your password.

If you need assistance at any point, don’t hesitate to reach out to our dedicated support team via live chat or email support@vectori.com

items.q: How do I change my email address?
items.a: Simply head to your account, select “my profile” and under “your info” you will be able to edit your email address.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: If you would like to delete your account, please reach out to our dedicated support team via live chat or email support@vectori.com and they will take care of the process for you.

items.q: How long do you store my photos?
items.a: if photos are uploaded via smart creation, but no project is started, they will be stored for 7 days. Photos in unordered projects will be saved for 45 days. Unused photos in an ordered project will be saved for 60 days. Used photos in an ordered project will be saved for 100 days.

items.q: Who can see my projects?
items.a: Only you and anyone you collaborate with can access your projects. Certain Vectori team members can access your projects in order to assist you and debug technical issues. Please be mindful of this when uploading photos.

items.q: Do you use my photos for marketing?
items.a: Nope! The only time we might use your photos for marketing is if you’ve left a public review. Any images we use in marketing require us to obtain full consent from the owner.

items.q: How do I manage email preferences?
items.a: Search for any Vectori marketing email you have received, scroll to the bottom and click “unsubscribe”. You will then be taken to a page where you can opt out of any Vectori emails.

items.q: How do I change my contact details?
items.a: To change your contact details, simply head to your account, click “my profile” and under “your info” you’ll be able to adjust your details.

items.q: Can I merge multiple accounts?
items.a: If you have multiple accounts and would like to transfer all projects into one account, please reach out to our dedicated support team via live chat or emailsupport@vectori.com who will be more than happy to assist you.

items.q: Do you offer bulk or wholesale orders?
items.a: We can provide quotes for large orders, but we do not offer wholesale at this current moment.

items.q: Can you provide a quote for a large order?
items.a: For large orders we can provide custom quotes. Please reach out to support@vectori.com with some additional info on the reason for the order.

items.q: Do you issue VAT invoices?
items.a: This is not something we offer at this current moment.

help:orders.title: order help
help:orders.body:
what if my order arrives incorrect?

1. Notification & Timeframe

In the unlikely event that you receive an incorrect order, you must notify us within 5 calendar days of delivery by contacting our customer service team at support@vectori.com. Please provide your order number, details of the incorrect items, and any supporting photos if applicable.

2. Resolution Options

Upon verification, we will offer one of the following resolutions:
• Replacement: We will arrange for the correct order to be delivered at no additional cost.
• Refund: If a replacement is not possible, we may issue a full or partial refund based on the circumstances.

3. Return / Disposal of Incorrect Items

In some cases, we may request that the incorrect items be returned or disposed of due to the contents of the order being confidential. We will provide instructions and cover any return shipping costs, if applicable. If a return is required but not completed within 30 calendar days, the refund or replacement may be canceled. 

4. Limitation of Liability

Our liability for incorrect order delivery is limited to the replacement or refund of the affected items. We are not responsible for any indirect losses or damages resulting from the incorrect order. 

5. Privacy Concerns

We value the privacy of our customers and comply with all applicable laws and regulations in relation to GDPR. However, incorrect order delivery may pose a risk of disclosure of third-party personal data to unintended recipients. Therefore, we urge our customers to check the contents of the order and not to copy, publish and/or share the contents of the order if it is the case of the incorrect order delivery, as we may not be held liable for mishandling one’s data in the event of incorrect delivery, should further copying, publishing or distribution of one’s data be facilitated by the unintended recipient (wrong customer).

help:refund-policy.title: refund policy
help:refund-policy.body:
VECTORI REFUND POLICY

Within 30 days of placing your order

We offer a 30 day satisfaction guarantee. If you're unsatisfied with your order please reach out to our dedicated support team

Damaged books / defects

We offer free reprints on damaged / defected books. If your order arrives damaged or defected please reach out to our dedicated support team support@vectori.com

Design mistakes

Unfortunately we cannot offer refunds or reprints due to mistakes made by customers during the editing process. We kindly ask all customers to double check their designs before ordering!

help:privacy-policy.title: privacy policy
help:privacy-policy.body:
This Privacy Policy describes how Vectori (the "Site", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and discloses your personal information when you visit, use our services, or make a purchase from vectori.com (the "Site") or otherwise communicate with us regarding the Site (collectively, the "Services"). For purposes of this Privacy Policy, "you" and "your" means you as the user of the Services, whether you are a customer, website visitor, or another individual whose information we have collected pursuant to this Privacy Policy. Please read this Privacy Policy carefully.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, including to reflect changes to our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will post the revised Privacy Policy on the Site, update the "Last updated" date and take any other steps required by applicable law.

How We Collect and Use Your Personal Information

To provide the Services, we collect personal information about you from a variety of sources, as set out below. The information that we collect and use varies depending on how you interact with us. In addition to the specific uses set out below, we may use information we collect about you to communicate with you, provide or improve or improve the Services, comply with any applicable legal obligations, enforce any applicable terms of service, and to protect or defend the Services, our rights, and the rights of our users or others.

What Personal Information We Collect

The types of personal information we obtain about you depends on how you interact with our Site and use our Services. When we use the term "personal information", we are referring to information that identifies, relates to, describes or can be associated with you. The following sections describe the categories and specific types of personal information we collect.

Information We Collect Directly from You

Information that you directly submit to us through our Services may include:

  • Contact details including your name, address, phone number, and email.
  • Order information including your name, billing address, shipping address, payment confirmation, email address, and phone number.
  • Account information including your username, password, security questions and other information used for account security purposes.
  • Customer support information including the information you choose to include in communications with us, for example, when sending a message through the Services.

Some features of the Services may require you to directly provide us with certain information about yourself. You may elect not to provide this information, but doing so may prevent you from using or accessing these features.

Information We Collect about Your Usage

We may also automatically collect certain information about your interaction with the Services ("Usage Data"). To do this, we may use cookies, pixels and similar technologies ("Cookies"). Usage Data may include information about how you access and use our Site and your account, including device information, browser information, information about your network connection, your IP address and other information regarding your interaction with the Services.

Information We Obtain from Third Parties

Finally, we may obtain information about you from third parties, including from vendors and service providers who may collect information on our behalf, such as:

Any information we obtain from third parties will be treated in accordance with this Privacy Policy. Also see the section below, Third Party Websites and Links.

  • Companies who support our Site and Services, such as Shopware.
  • Our payment processors, who collect payment information (e.g., bank account, credit or debit card information, billing address) to process your payment in order to fulfill
  • your orders and provide you with products or services you have requested, in order to perform our contract with you.
  • When you visit our Site, open or click on emails we send you, or interact with our Services or advertisements, we, or third parties we work with, may automatically collect
  • certain information using online tracking technologies such as pixels, web beacons, software developer kits, third-party libraries, and cookies.

How We Use Your Personal Information

Providing Products and Services. We use your personal information to provide you with the Services in order to perform our contract with you, including to process your payments, fulfill your orders, to send notifications to you related to your account, purchases, returns, exchanges or other transactions, to create, maintain and otherwise manage your account, to arrange for shipping, facilitate any returns and exchanges and other features and functionalities related to your account. We may also enhance your shopping experience by enabling Shopware to match your account with other Shopware services that you may choose to use. In this case, Shopware will process your information as set forth in its Privacy Policy and Consumer Privacy Policy.

Marketing and Advertising. We may use your personal information for marketing and promotional purposes, such as to send marketing, advertising and promotional communications by email, text message or postal mail, and to show you advertisements for products or services. This may include using your personal information to etter tailor the Services and advertising on our Site and other websites. If you are an EEA resident, the legal basis for these data processing activities is our legitimate interest in selling our products, according to Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

Security and Fraud Prevention. We use your personal information to detect, investigate or take action regarding possible fraudulent, illegal or malicious activity. If you choose to use the Services and register an account, you are responsible for keeping your account credentials safe. We highly recommend that you do not share your username, password, or other access details with anyone else. If you believe your account has been compromised, please contact us immediately. If you are an EEA resident, the legal basis for these data processing activities is our legitimate interest in keeping our website secure for you and other customers, according to Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

Communicating with You and Service Improvement. We use your personal information to provide you with customer support and improve our Services. This is in our legitimate interests in order to be responsive to you, to provide effective services to you, and to maintain our business relationship with you according to Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR.

Cookies

Like many websites, we use Cookies on our Site. We use Cookies to power and improve our Site and our Services (including to remember your actions and preferences), to run analytics and better understand user interaction with the Services (in our legitimate interests to administer, improve and optimize the Services). We may also permit third parties and services providers to use Cookies on our Site to better tailor the services, products and advertising on our Site and other websites.
Most browsers automatically accept Cookies by default, but you can choose to set your browser to remove or reject Cookies through your browser controls. Please keep in mind that removing or blocking Cookies can negatively impact your user experience and may cause some of the Services, including certain features and general functionality, to work incorrectly or no longer be available. Additionally, blocking Cookies may not completely prevent how we share information with third parties such as our advertising partners.

How We Disclose Personal Information

In certain circumstances, we may disclose your personal information to third parties for contract fulfilment purposes, legitimate purposes and other reasons subject to this Privacy Policy. Such circumstances may include:

  • With vendors or other third parties who perform services on our behalf (e.g., IT management, payment processing, data analytics, customer support, cloud storage, fulfilment and shipping).
  • With business and marketing partners to provide services and advertise to you. Our business and marketing partners will use your information in accordance with their own privacy notices.
  • When you direct, request us or otherwise consent to our disclosure of certain information to third parties, such as to ship you products or through your use of social media widgets or login integrations, with your consent.
  • With our affiliates or otherwise within our corporate group, in our legitimate interests to run a successful business.
  • In connection with a business transaction such as a merger or bankruptcy, to comply with any applicable legal obligations (including to respond to subpoenas, search warrants and similar requests), to enforce any applicable terms of service, and to protect or defend the Services, our rights, and the rights of our users or others.

We disclose the following categories of personal information and sensitive personal information about users for the purposes set out above in "How we Collect and Use your Personal Information" and "How we Disclose Personal Information":

Category

  • Identifiers such as basic contact details and certain order and account information
  • Commercial information such as order information, shopping information and customer support information
  • Internet or other similar network activity, such as Usage Data
  • Geolocation data such as locations determined by an IP address or other technical measures

Categories of Recipients

  • Vendors and third parties who perform services on our behalf (such as Internet service providers, payment processors, fulfillment partners, customer support partners and data analytics providers)
  • Business and marketing partners
  • Affiliates

We do not use or disclose sensitive personal information without your consent or for the purposes of inferring characteristics about you.

User Generated Content

The Services may enable you to post product reviews and other user-generated content. If you choose to submit user generated content to any public area of the Services, this content will be public and accessible by anyone. We do not control who will have access to the information that you choose to make available to others, and cannot ensure that parties who have access to such information will respect your privacy or keep it secure. We are not responsible for the privacy or security of any information that you make publicly available, or for the accuracy, use or misuse of any information that you disclose or receive from third parties.

Third Party Websites and Links

Our Site may provide links to websites or other online platforms operated by third parties. If you follow links to sites not affiliated or controlled by us, you should review their privacy and security policies and other terms and conditions. We do not guarantee and are not responsible for the privacy or security of such sites, including the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of information found on these sites. Information you provide on public or semi-public venues, including information you share on third-party social etworking platforms may also be viewable by other users of the Services and/or users of those third-party platforms without limitation as to its use by us or by a third party. Our inclusion of such links does not, by itself, imply any endorsement of the content on such platforms or of their owners or operators, except as disclosed on the Services.

Children's Data

The Services are not intended to be used by children, and we do not knowingly collect any personal information about children. If you are the parent or guardian of a child who has provided us with their personal information, you may contact us using the contact details set out below to request that it be deleted. As of the Effective Date of this Privacy Policy, we do not have actual knowledge that we “share” or “sell” (as those terms are defined in applicable law) personal information of individuals under 16 years of age.

Security and Retention of Your Information

Please be aware that no security measures are perfect or impenetrable, and we cannot guarantee “perfect security.” In addition, any information you send to us may not be secure while in transit. We recommend that you do not use insecure channels to communicate sensitive or confidential information to us. How long we retain your personal information depends on different factors, such as whether we need the information to maintain your account, to provide the Services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes or enforce other applicable contracts and policies.

Your Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have some or all of the rights listed below in relation to your personal information. However, these rights are not absolute, may apply only in certain circumstances and, in certain cases, we may decline your request as permitted by law.

  • Right to Access / Know: You may have a right to request access to personal information that we hold about you, including details relating to the ways in which we use and share your information.
  • Right to Delete: You may have a right to request that we delete personal information we maintain about you.
  • Right to Correct: You may have a right to request that we correct inaccurate personal information we maintain about you.
  • Right of Portability: You may have a right to receive a copy of the personal information we hold about you and to request that we transfer it to a third party, in certain circumstances and with certain exceptions.
  • Restriction of Processing: You may have the right to ask us to stop or restrict our processing of personal information.
  • Withdrawal of Consent: Where we rely on consent to process your personal information, you may have the right to withdraw this consent.
  • Appeal: You may have a right to appeal our decision if we decline to process your request. You can do so by replying directly to our denial.
  • Managing Communication Preferences: We may send you promotional emails, and you may opt out of receiving these at any time by using the unsubscribe option displayed in our emails to you. If you opt out, we may still send you non-promotional emails, such as those about your account or orders that you have made.

You may exercise any of these rights where indicated on our Site or by contacting us using the contact details provided below. We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of these rights. We may need to collect information from you to verify your identity, such as your email address or account information, before providing a substantive response to the request. In accordance with applicable laws, you may designate an authorized agent to make requests on your behalf to exercise your rights. Before accepting such a request from an agent, we will require that the agent provide proof you have authorized them to act on your behalf, and we may need you to verify your identity directly with us. We will respond to your request in a timely manner as required under applicable law.

Complaints

If you have complaints about how we process your personal information, please contact us using the contact details provided below. If you are not satisfied with our response to your complaint, depending on where you live you may have the right to appeal our decision by contacting us using the contact details set out below, or lodge your complaint with your local data protection authority. For the EEA, you can find a list of the responsible data protection supervisory authorities 

International Users

Please note that we may transfer, store and process your personal information outside the country you live in. Your personal information is also processed by staff and third party service providers and partners in these countries. If we transfer your personal information out of Europe, we will rely on recognized transfer mechanisms like the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses, or any equivalent contracts issued by the relevant competent authority of the UK, as relevant, unless the data transfer is to a country that has been determined to provide an adequate level of protection.

Contact

Should you have any questions about our privacy practices or this Privacy Policy, or if you would like to exercise any of the rights available to you, please call or email us at support@vectori.com. For the purpose of applicable data protection laws and if not explicitly stated otherwise, we are the data controller of your personal information.

help:cookies-policy.body:
OVERVIEW

Cookies Policy for vectori.com (US, UK, EU, Australia)

We are Ascend Group LLC (T/A Vectori). This cookie policy outlines how we collect, use, and manage cookies, and we outline your rights and choices regarding cookie usage. This policy applies to all visitors worldwide and the policy shall be interpreted in accordance with laws and regulations of the country of the visitor, i.e. the United Kingdom, European Union, United States, Australia.

We use cookies to make our website work properly, improve your browsing experience, analyse site traffic, and deliver personalized advertising (where permitted by law).

Use of cookies

Vectori website uses cookies. A cookie is a small file of letters and numbers the website puts on your device if you allow it. These cookies recognise when your device has visited our website(s) before, so we can distinguish you from other users of the website. This improves your experience and our website functionality. 

We do not use cookies to identify you, just to improve your experience on our website(s). If you do not wish to use the cookies, you can amend the settings on your internet browser so it will not automatically download cookies. However, if you remove or block cookies on your computer, please be aware that your browsing experience and our website’s functionality may be affected.

Why we use cookies

We use cookies for various purposes, including but not limited to:


  • To remember your preferences (e.g. language, currency)
  • To enable features like shopping cart functionality
  • To gather analytics about how people use our site (e.g. which pages are visited, how long)
  • To show relevant ads (if applicable) What cookies we use
  • Strictly necessary cookies: These are cookies that are required for the operation of our website. They include, for example, cookies that enable you to access and log into secure areas of our website or make use of e-billing services. 
  • Session cookies: also known as 'temporary cookies', help websites recognise users and the information provided when they navigate through a website. Session cookies only retain information about a user's activities for as long as they are on the website. Once the web browser is closed, the cookies are deleted. 
  • Permanent cookies: also known as 'persistent cookies', remain in operation even after the website has closed. For example, they can remember login details and passwords, so website users don't need to re-enter them every time they use the website. The law states that permanent cookies must be deleted after 12 months.

    • Cookie consent & management

  • On your first visit, you will see a banner asking you to accept or decline non-essential cookies.
  • You can change or withdraw your consent at any time via the “Cookie Settings” link in the footer or “Cookie Preferences” page.
  • You can also control cookies via your browser settings. If you block or delete cookies, some parts of the website may not function properly.
  • for more information generally on cookies, including how to disable them, please refer to aboutcookies.org. You will also find details on how to delete cookies from your device.

Attribution cookies

To understand which marketing channels bring visitors to our website, we store a small number of first-party attribution cookies. These are set by us (not by any third party), contain no personally identifying information, and are used only in aggregate to measure the performance of our campaigns.


  • px_first_touch — records the marketing channel of your first visit (e.g. an email click, an ad, an organic search). Written once and never overwritten. Lifetime: 365 days.
  • px_last_touch — records the marketing channel of your most recent visit that came from an identifiable source. Refreshed on each new identifiable visit; never overwritten by direct traffic. Lifetime: 30 days.
  • px_touch_state — small counter and fingerprint used to assign a sequence number to each new marketing touch and to avoid recording the same click twice within 30 minutes. Lifetime: 365 days.
  • px_touch_emit — one-shot signal written when a new marketing touch is recorded, so our analytics layer can emit a single tracking event on the next page load. Cleared immediately after it fires. Lifetime: session (deleted when you close the tab).

Third-party cookies

We may use certain trusted third-party services (e.g. Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel) that may also place cookies for analytics, advertising or functionality purposes. These cookies are governed by those third parties’ cookie policies.

Regulatory Requirements

EU / UK

  • Under the GDPR and UK Data Protection Act, we require your consent for all non-essential cookies.
  • You can accept or decline cookies through the cookie banner when you first visit our site.
  • You can withdraw consent at any time via the “Cookie Settings” link in the footer.

USA (including California)

  • Under the CCPA/CPRA, you have the right to opt out of “sale” or “sharing” of personal data for targeted advertising.
  • You can exercise this right by submitting a “Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information” request to our email: [email].  

Australia

  • Under the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and Australian Privacy Principles, we obtain consent where required and ensure transparency in how we use cookies.
  • You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings.

Contact us

If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy, please contact us atsupport@vectori.com

Legal information

This privacy statement has been prepared based on provisions of multiple legislations. This privacy policy relates solely to this website, if not stated otherwise within this document.
We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted here with an updated “last revised” date. The date of the most recent revision of this policy is stated below. 

Last revised: 8 October, 2025

ambassadorFaq.q: What’s included in the base price?
ambassadorFaq.a: The base price includes 24 pages. The base price will change depending on what book or magazine type you choose

ambassadorFaq.q: Do I have to pay for extra pages?
ambassadorFaq.a:
Yes, our extra page costs are as follows:

Photobooks
Gloss paper - $1.99 per additional page ($3.98 per double page spread).
Premium luster - $6.99 per additional page ($13.98 per double page spread).

Magazines
Gloss paper - coming soon.

Shipping costs vary depending on your location and the product you order, including the number of pages and product type. The exact cost will be calculated and shown at checkout.

We offer free shipping on larger books, but the threshold varies by country:

  • US, UK, Germany, Czech Republic, Denmark, Netherlands, Sweden: Free shipping for books over 50 pages
  • Australia, France, Italy, Spain, Belgium, Finland, Portugal: Free shipping for books over 60 pages
  • New Zealand, Bulgaria, Croatia, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Switzerland, UAE: Free shipping for books over 70 pages
  • Canada, Norway, Mexico, Singapore: Free shipping for books over 100 pages


The free shipping option will appear automatically at checkout if your order qualifies.
Yep! Once you’re in the editor, simply click on the spine text box and you’ll be able to change the text, color and size. Be careful not to make it too big in case it gets cut off!

ambassadorFaq.q: Can I edit text, fonts, and colors?
ambassadorFaq.a: Yes, text, fonts and colors are all fully customisable in our editor.

ambassadorFaq.q: Can I switch templates after I start?
ambassadorFaq.a:
Of course! If you wanted to change the template you originally picked, you can do so within the editor. 

On desktop, simply head to the side panel to the left of the editor and second from the top, under “images” there will be a “templates” option where you can choose from all of our templates.

On mobile, simply head to the bottom right of your screen where you’ll find an arrow. Click this and a “templates” option will appear. Click this and then select the new template.

Note, if you are in the editor, all of our templates will be accessible, so don’t worry if you entered the editor via a specific collection, you’ll have every template on our website for that product available to you.

ambassadorFaq.q: Will my images look the same in real life as they do on my screen?
ambassadorFaq.a: There might be a small difference in how colors appear in print compared to your screen — that’s completely normal. Screens use light to show colors, while printing uses ink, and things like screen brightness or color settings can make images look a bit different. Your photos will still look beautiful and true to the originals!

ambassadorFaq.q: Are your materials sustainable or eco-friendly?
ambassadorFaq.a: Yes! Our printing partners use HP Indigo machines with FSC-certified paper — meaning the paper comes from responsibly managed forests that protect nature and local communities. Since we print on demand, each book or magazine is made only when ordered, avoiding unnecessary waste. And thanks to our global print network, every order is produced as close as possible to its destination, helping reduce transport distance and CO₂ emissions.

ambassadorFaq.q: Can I send as a gift without pricing info inside?
ambassadorFaq.a: Yes! We don’t include any invoices or pricing information in the package, so it’s perfect for gifting.

ambassadorFaq.q: What is your return and refund policy?
ambassadorFaq.a:
We want you to love your creations! So, we offer a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. If you’re not happy with your order, please reach out to our support team at support@vectori.com.

If your book arrives damaged or with a printing defect, we’ll happily send you a free reprint. Just contact our team at support@vectori.com and include a few photos of the issue.

Because each book is custom-made, we’re unable to offer refunds or reprints for design errors made during the creation process. Please make sure to double-check your layout, text, and photos before placing your order.
